entries.basis: Explicit light/dark/system and initial server/host contracts are documented. The accepted24case React18/19×locale×engine×system-preference execution covers the named gated prehydration styling successor without browser reads in server render, while preserving fixed nested scopes and zero hydration diagnostics.
entries.criterion: - [ ] A-D-17 Reconcile original `D-17`: Specify explicit light/dark/system settings, initial server theme, `color-scheme`, and hydration behavior without unwanted flashes or browser-global assumptions. Historical status: open.

limits: Reuse actual recorded tarball lifecycle evidence; no fresh browser execution. Computed pre/post-hydration style consistency is not universal first-paint/deployment certification. Hosts must load initial CSS and serialize consistent theme/locale/default inputs; speech/physical devices and release approval remain separate.
